We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and ship scalable
TypeScript services on our distributed platform. You'll own backend
APIs, work closely with frontend teams, and contribute to our
event-driven architecture.

Required:
- 5+ years of backend engineering with TypeScript or Java
- Strong experience with REST APIs and Postgres
- Comfortable with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
- Excellent communication; comfortable mentoring junior engineers

Nice to have:
- Kafka or another streaming platform
- Kubernetes experience
- Spring Boot exposure

We use GitHub Actions for CI and ship multiple times a day.
